en-US: Private capture: open History after unlocking to review unfinished entries, confirm the account and category, and save once. Plan: tap a category for transactions, merchant, exact category amount (including splits and refunds), spending and remaining budget. Assets: tap an account for its balance and transactions. Check hidden amounts and larger text sizes.
zh-Hans: 私密记录：解锁后打开历史记录，核对待完成记录的账户与分类并保存。计划：点按分类查看交易、商户、本分类金额（含拆分交易与退款）、支出和预算余额。资产：点按账户查看余额与交易明细。请检查隐藏金额和大字体显示。
